advancement.woolworks.root.title: Wool Works
advancement.woolworks.root.description: Turn ordinary sheep into resource-producing companions with Wool Works!
advancement.woolworks.resource_feed.desc: Feed a sheep Resource Feed to transform it into a sheep that produces valuable resources.
advancement.woolworks.infused_wool.title: Shear Genius
advancement.woolworks.infused_wool.descr: Shear resource sheep to collect Infused Wool, which can be converted into resources or energy.
advancement.woolworks.wool_generator.des: Convert Infused Wool into Forge Energy to power your machines.
advancement.woolworks.wool_insulated_cab: Transfer energy between machines. Use Shears to toggle energy extraction connections.
advancement.woolworks.wool_extractor.des: Use energy to extract valuable resources from Infused Wool.
advancement.woolworks.woolly_speed_upgra: Speed up extraction without increasing energy consumption per tick. Install up to eight upgrades.
advancement.woolworks.woolly_overdrive_u: Extract resources faster and multiply output at the cost of increased energy usage. Install up to two upgrades.
advancement.woolworks.wool_worker.title: Shear Automation
advancement.woolworks.wool_worker.descri: Automatically shear nearby sheep and use wheat to regrow their wool. Right-click with Shears to visualize the working area.
advancement.woolworks.woolly_muffler.des: Right-click machines to mute their sounds or silence sheep within a Wool Worker's working area.
config.woolworks.cableExtractionIndicato: Choose square or line indicators for cable extraction connections.
gui.woolworks.worker.shears_desc: Used to shear wool from sheep.
gui.woolworks.worker.visualization: Right-click the machine with Shears to show or hide the working area.
item.woolworks.wool_insulated_cable.pick: Sneak-right-click with shears to pick up
gui.woolworks.output_too_large: Multiplied output exceeds the output slot capacity.
item.woolworks.wool_insulated_cable.extr: Right-click an energy connection with shears to toggle extraction
item.woolworks.woolly_muffler.machine: Right-click a machine to cycle its muffle mode.
item.woolworks.woolly_muffler.sheep: Can also mute sheep in a Wool Worker's working area.
woolworks.configuration.title: Wool Works Configuration
woolworks.configuration.enableAutomaticM: Automatically enable supported resources provided by installed mods.
woolworks.configuration.disabledResource: Choose which resource types are enabled or disabled.
woolworks.resources.title: Enabled Resources
woolworks.resources.restart: Restart the world and reconnect after changes.
woolworks.resources.unavailable: Enter a singleplayer world to load resource definitions. Server administrators can edit the server config file.
woolworks.resources.global: Globally disabled by Automatic Modded Resources; your individual preference is preserved.
woolworks.resources.restricted: Disabled by its resource definition; edit the datapack to enable it.
woolworks.resources.missing_tag: The resource's required item tag is missing or empty.
woolworks.configuration.cableTransferRat: Maximum energy transferred through each cable per server tick.
woolworks.configuration.woolWorkerOperat: Server ticks between Wool Worker operation cycles. 20 ticks is approximately one second.
woolworks.configuration.woolWorkerRegrow: Energy consumed for each successful wool regrowth, capped at machine capacity.
woolworks.configuration.woolWorkerSheari: Energy consumed for each successful shearing, capped at machine capacity.
woolworks.configuration.woolWorkerWheatC: Wheat consumed each time the Wool Worker regrows a sheep's wool.
woolworks.configuration.woolWorkerShears: Durability consumed per successful shearing operation. Set to zero to disable durability consumption.
